description: Jazz Jackrabbit 2 (Jazz² Resurrection with game data and multiplayer)
long: Jazz Jackrabbit 2 is a fast-paced side-scrolling platformer starring the green rabbit Jazz and his brother Spaz. Players run, jump and shoot through colorful cartoon levels collecting gems and power-ups. The Jazz2 Resurrection reimplementation adds online and local multiplayer, including cooperative and competitive modes on modern systems.
